translation: Gather in the second and eighth months. (Scutellaria 黃芩, dragon bone 龍骨, and 理石 are its envoys; [it is averse to] chrysanthemum 菊花, 芫花, figwort 玄參, and 白蘚, is in dread of coltsfoot 款冬, overcomes aconite 烏頭, and resolves the poison of croton 巴豆.) Original text of the Benjing: Coptis (黃連), flavor bitter
